project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React 18 + Vite 7 SPA frontend, Node.js (ESM) Express 5 API backend, MongoDB (Mongoose 8) / DocumentDB in prod, AWS serverless (Lambda + API Gateway + Terraform) migration in progress
language: JavaScript (ESM on backend, JSX on frontend)
build_system: npm workspaces-style (separate backend/ and frontend/ package.json). Backend: no real build (echo). Frontend: vite build. Node 22 via nvm at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin (add to PATH; `node` is NOT on default PATH).
test_framework: Backend: Jest 29 with babel-jest ESM transform, two projects ('unit' and 'db'); 'db' project uses tests/setup.js with mongodb-memory-server. Frontend: Vitest + @testing-library/react; Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e.
build_command: Backend: (cd backend && npm run build). Frontend: (cd frontend && npm run build). Always `export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH` first.
test_command: Backend: (cd backend && npm test). Frontend: (cd frontend && npm test). Backend unit-only (used by CI): (cd backend && npx jest --selectProjects unit).
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH to node 22. 2) Backend: npm install; npm test (baseline: 88 failing / 62 passing before fixes). 3) Frontend: npm install; npm test (baseline: 233 failing / 156 passing). 4) Backend lint: npm run lint (baseline: ESLint cannot find config, hard fail). 5) Optionally seed with MONGODB_URI set: npm run seed:comprehensive. Docker: docker-compose.yml exists but requires a Mongo container; use only if a Docker daemon is available.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Frontend build output dist/ is gitignored. No snapshot test directories.
setup_instructions: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH; cd backend && npm install; cd ../frontend && npm install. Backend needs a .env (copy backend/.env.example). Local run needs MongoDB; mongodb-memory-server is used for tests so no external Mongo is required for the test suites.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22 default (CI pins Node 20). AWS CLI v2 present and credentials valid (account 583168584925). NO Cloudinary/Resend/SES credentials are provisioned - real image upload and real email sending cannot be verified end-to-end without secrets; verify these paths with graceful-degradation behavior and unit tests instead. Do NOT run Terraform apply (provisions real AWS resources). A local MongoDB daemon may not be running; rely on mongodb-memory-server for tests.
contribution_requirements: From .kiro/steering/project-overview.md: backend is ESM (`type: module`); AWS SDK v3 modular imports only; do not add DynamoDB (use DocumentDB); do not switch to TypeScript; do not put secrets in env in Terraform (use Secrets Manager); Cognito is enabled only when COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID+COGNITO_CLIENT_ID both set; Lambda detected via AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME. Keep changes SIMPLE per user: fix existing functionality, do not add complex new features.
key_patterns: API responses use { success, data, message } or { success:false, error:{ message, code } }. Backend auth is split/inconsistent: routes/auth.js /me, routes/users.js, routes/tasks (via users), routes/upload.js use authenticateToken (Bearer JWT/Cognito), while routes/teams.js and routes/projects.js use `auth` (Passport session req.isAuthenticated()). Frontend (services/api.js) is SESSION-COOKIE based (withCredentials:true) and sends NO Bearer token. Login/register use Passport sessions and return no token. User model uses fullname/username (NOT name); onboarding stored under user.onboarding {completed,currentStep,completedSteps,completedAt}. Email via config/resend.js (returns graceful failure when RESEND_API_KEY unset). Cloudinary configured in config/cloudinary.js with multer CloudinaryStorage and exported `upload` middleware, but routes/upload.js was replaced with S3-presign only and has NO multipart POST /upload/avatar endpoint the frontend calls.
